rule_title: TTP for audit policy clearance attempts
description: Detects automated local account password brute forcing via the Windows Advapi LogonType 2 interface. Legitimate interactive logon failures (EID 4625 LogonType 2) come exclusively from winlogon.exe — any other ProcessName in the 4625 event indicates a tool is calling LogonUser() or similar APIs to test passwords locally without the Windows GUI. AccountRestore, NirSoft tools, and custom brute-force scripts all leave this signature. SubStatus 0xc000006a confirms wrong password rather than locked/disabled.
